from.place: Tag 03N0 proof: identify the finite standard affine coproduct with the spectrum of the product ring

title: Finite coproducts of affine schemes are spectra of product rings
statement: For a finite set $J$ and a family of commutative rings $(A_j)_{j\in J}$, the canonical morphism $\coprod_{j\in J}\operatorname{Spec}(A_j)\to\operatorname{Spec}(\prod_{j\in J}A_j)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is an isomorphism, and under this isomorphism the $j$-th coprojection is $\operatorname{Spec}$ of the projection $\prod_{k\in J}A_k\to A_j$.
